veya/__init__.py.purpose: package entry point; public API and veya.load checkpoint loading (hash-pinned in the release manifest)

veya/agent.py.purpose: Agent: ModernBERT decision model, packed choice/score/noul inference and system_one multi-question answering (hash-pinned)

veya/common.py.purpose: shared utilities: sequence building, collation, confidence_from_probs, ECE, safe_automation_coverage (hash-pinned)

veya/selective.py.purpose: selective prediction: policy loading, score_probabilities, risk-coverage, Wilson intervals (hash-pinned)

veya/release_bundle.py.purpose: release bundle loading with SHA-256 verification; packed vs shortlist-k8 routing; public_choice and answer_questions (hash-pinned)

veya/manifest.py.purpose: checkpoint manifest authoring and SHA-256 computation (hash-pinned)

veya/server.py.purpose: model server: /v1/* inference endpoints, /health, /version; process-wide _INFER_LOCK serializes inference (hash-pinned)

veya/router.py.purpose: route selection across english/multilingual/typed-decisions checkpoints via script and language detection (hash-pinned)

veya/shortlist.py.purpose: shortlist candidate retrieval for choice; PRODUCTION_SHORTLIST_K=8, trigger above 19 candidates (hash-pinned)

veya/shortlist_artifact.py.purpose: shortlist projection artifact loading with hash and checkpoint binding checks (hash-pinned)

veya/reranker.py.purpose: reranker head scoring shortlisted choice candidates (hash-pinned)

veya/calibration.py.purpose: per-cardinality temperature calibration loading, hash-bound to the checkpoint (hash-pinned)

veya/lang.py.purpose: script/language detection and defer_reason gate returning 'unsupported_language' (hash-pinned)

veya/train.py.purpose: reference trainer streaming the HF typed-decisions dataset; not part of the served runtime

veya/experimental/.purpose: research-only modules (hypothesis, ordinal, candidate_set, domain_retriever, top8); declared package, not hash-pinned, not loaded by the release manifest

web/server.py.purpose: web gateway / HTTP serving: static site, /api/infer, /api/health, /api/version; rate limiting, MAX_INFLIGHT=2, CSP and origin controls (not hash-pinned)

web/contracts.py.purpose: request/response validation: primitive whitelist, candidate limits (2-100 choice, 2-10 score, 1-8 questions), 12 KB state cap, upstream response whitelisting (not hash-pinned)

web/model_server.py.purpose: model server process launcher: load_release_manifest startup path (not hash-pinned)

web/static/.purpose: static site assets served by the gateway (not hash-pinned)

research/.purpose: benchmarks, evaluation harnesses, training scripts, and datasets

research/veyabench/.purpose: evaluation protocols and harnesses (blind CLINC150, MASSIVE, robustness gates)

models/production/.purpose: frozen audited checkpoint, tokenizer, shortlist_k8.pt, calibrations, choice_router.json — all hash-pinned via the manifest

artifacts/release/manifest.json.purpose: release manifest v2: SHA-256 pins for runtime files and every served artifact

hash_pinned_boundary.description: veya/*.py runtime files listed in manifest.runtime_files are SHA-256-pinned; release_bundle.load_release_manifest recomputes every hash at startup and refuses to load on mismatch. web/* and veYa/experimental are outside this boundary.

optional_dependencies.datasets: training only (veya/train.py); not needed by the shipped runtime
